title: A tree frog
why: Look at the sticky round toes and the big eyes: they help a frog climb leaves and catch insects near water.

title: A camel of the desert
why: Look at the hump, the long legs and the wide feet: they help a camel live where there is little water and hot sand.
credit: “Camel” by local.yany, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A sea turtle
why: Look at the flat flippers and smooth shell: they help a turtle swim through the sea.
credit: “Sea turtle” by C.J..Goldman, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
